content:
fix: three memory safety issues in text parsing

Bound UTF-8 byte copies in CheckDottedAbbrev(), validate dictionary_skipwords before writing into clause words, and pass an explicit WORD_TAB remaining count through the internal translation helpers for bounded multi-word lookahead.

The public TranslateWord() signature is unchanged. Related internal WORD_TAB lookahead in number/Roman handling and CombineFlag() uses the same bound.
